title: Your saved searches
description: Catalog searches you have saved, with the filters that were active.

help.title: About Saved searches
help.overview: A saved search is a catalog filter a customer named so they can run it again. It is not a product, an order, or a collection; it only remembers how the catalog was narrowed.

sections.title: What is stored
sections.body: The name is the label; the rest is the filter.
items: Categories can be several; collection is one.
Minimum price, maximum price, and sort are optional. An empty one is simply not applied.
The customer is the owner of the search.

sections.title: Whose searches this page shows
sections.body: The same records are listed two ways.
items: From the eCommerce menu, this page lists every saved search in the company, and a new one asks which customer it belongs to.
As a customer's own list, it shows only theirs, and a new search is filed under that customer.
Deleting a saved search is a soft delete and it can be restored.

sections.title: What it does not do
sections.body: Saving a search changes nothing in the catalog.
items: It does not hide products, change prices, or create a collection.
Running it again applies the same filter to the catalog as it is now, not as it was when saved.

catalogDescription: Every catalog search saved by a customer.
